name: Tesla Jolt

features.name: Charged Wilds
features.description: Three stored wilds are released back onto the reels.

review:
Tesla Jolt is an early 5x3 Nolimit City slot where the Tesla Jolt symbol on reel 5 turns a random symbol into a wild. Three or more scatters award 10, 15 or 20 Tesla Spins with Charged Wilds: wilds on reels 2 to 4 are stored, and once three are stored they're released back onto their reel.

Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 96.61% RTP and a 582x cap. A calm, steampunk-tinged classic.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
